note: Boundaries on the GICC05 time scale, entered by hand from a cited table; ages in years b2k (before 2000 CE). verified stays false until read on the paper's own page. scripts/icecore.ts does not write this file.

events.name: Start of GS-1, the Younger Dryas
events.note: IntChron's event table for Walker et al. 2009 gives t = -10896 (calendar year, so 12,896 b2k), t_sigma 2, source GICC05. The data file's maximum counting error there is about 138 years (2 sigma).

events.name: Start of the Holocene, the end of the Younger Dryas
events.note: IntChron's event table for Walker et al. 2009 gives t = -9703 (calendar year, so 11,703 b2k), t_sigma 2, source GICC05: the GSSP for the base of the Holocene. The data file's maximum counting error there is about 99 years (2 sigma).
